mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PAYMENTS (reservation_id, user_id, order_id, payment_key, amount, pay_status, approved_at, ins_id, ins_ip) VALUES (#{reservationId}, #{userId}, #{orderId}, #{paymentKey}, #{amount}, #{payStatus}, #{approvedAt}, #{insId}, #{insIp})

INSERT INTO REFUND (payment_id, cancel_amount, cancel_reason, toss_transaction_key, canceled_at, ins_id, ins_ip) VALUES (#{paymentId}, #{cancelAmount}, #{cancelReason}, #{tossTransactionKey}, #{canceledAt}, #{insId}, #{insIp})
mapper.select: SELECT payment_id AS paymentId, reservation_id AS reservationId, user_id AS userId, order_id AS orderId, payment_key AS paymentKey, amount, pay_status AS payStatus, approved_at AS approvedAt FROM PAYMENTS WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT p.payment_id AS paymentId, p.reservation_id AS reservationId, p.user_id AS userId, p.order_id AS orderId, p.payment_key AS paymentKey, p.amount, p.pay_status AS payStatus, p.approved_at AS approvedAt, s.seat_row AS seatRow, s.seat_colume AS seatColume, s.grade, perf.p_title AS pTitle, v.venue_name AS venueName, pr.round_time AS roundTime FROM PAYMENTS p JOIN RESERVATIONS r ON p.reservation_id = r.reservation_id JOIN SEATS s ON r.seat_id = s.seat_id JOIN PERFORMANCE_ROUND pr ON r.round_id = pr.round_id JOIN PERFORMANCES perf ON pr.performance_id = perf.performance_id LEFT JOIN VENUE v ON perf.venue_id = v.venue_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY p.approved_at DESC

SELECT p.payment_id AS paymentId, p.reservation_id AS reservationId, p.user_id AS userId, p.order_id AS orderId, p.payment_key AS paymentKey, p.amount, p.pay_status AS payStatus, p.approved_at AS approvedAt, s.seat_row AS seatRow, s.seat_colume AS seatColume, s.grade, perf.p_title AS pTitle, v.venue_name AS venueName, pr.round_time AS roundTime FROM PAYMENTS p JOIN RESERVATIONS r ON p.reservation_id = r.reservation_id JOIN SEATS s ON r.seat_id = s.seat_id JOIN PERFORMANCE_ROUND pr ON r.round_id = pr.round_id JOIN PERFORMANCES perf ON pr.performance_id = perf.performance_id LEFT JOIN VENUE v ON perf.venue_id = v.venue_id WHERE p.payment_id = #{paymentId}

SELECT p.payment_id AS paymentId, p.reservation_id AS reservationId, p.user_id AS userId, u.user_nm AS userNm, p.order_id AS orderId, p.payment_key AS paymentKey, p.amount, p.pay_status AS payStatus, p.approved_at AS approvedAt, s.seat_row AS seatRow, s.seat_colume AS seatColume, s.grade, perf.p_title AS pTitle, v.venue_name AS venueName, pr.round_time AS roundTime FROM PAYMENTS p JOIN USERS u ON p.user_id = u.user_id JOIN RESERVATIONS r ON p.reservation_id = r.reservation_id JOIN SEATS s ON r.seat_id = s.seat_id JOIN PERFORMANCE_ROUND pr ON r.round_id = pr.round_id JOIN PERFORMANCES perf ON pr.performance_id = perf.performance_id LEFT JOIN VENUE v ON perf.venue_id = v.venue_id
AND p.pay_status = #{payStatus}
AND (p.user_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.user_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR perf.p_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY p.approved_at DESC
